title: SH-GD/SM-L: Dynamic Alternative-Path Selection for AI Agents Based on Learned Schema Compatibility and State Monitoring - code and results
description: Reference implementation, experiment harnesses, result logs and the scripts that generate every number, table and figure of the article 'SH-GD/SM-L: Dynamic Alternative-Path Selection for AI Agents Based on Learned Schema Compatibility and State Monitoring' (revised manuscript resubmitted to IEEE Access). Version 2.0.0 adds the retry and hand-over transition rule, runs with Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5, and the experiments added in the revision.
